programs.title: Discovering Film
programs.desc: A look into the life and career of one of Hollywood's most recognisable stars, known for her work in The Colour Purple, Sister Act, Glory and more.

programs.title: The Snows of Kilimanjaro
programs.desc: Gregory Peck heads a celebrated cast that includes Susan Hayward and Ava Gardner in this sweeping film filled with exotic settings – from Africa to Paris to Spain – based on the popular story by Ernest Hemingway. As Harry Street (Peck), a frustrated author/big game hunter, lies dying in the shadow of Africa’s Mount Kilimanjaro, he recounts his goals, his frustrations and his great loves.

programs.title: Master Cheng (A Spice For Life)
programs.desc: Following the death of his wife, professional chef Cheng travels with his young son to a remote village in Finland to connect with an old Finnish friend he once met in Shanghai.

programs.title: The Last Castle
programs.desc: The story of a respected and decorated general whose career ends in disgrace when he disobeys orders and is sent to a maximum-security prison dubbed the Castle. Perceiving the injustice at work within the prison system, he rallies his fellow convicts into a rag-tag army and mounts a revolt against the autocratic warden, who runs the institution with an iron fist.

programs.title: The Fence
programs.desc: Motorbikes, fast carrs, punch-ups and 80's music. Set on the streets of 1980s Bristol, this retro flick follows a council estate kid out to settle the score with local thieves.

programs.title: The Ideal Palace
programs.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'.
